title: French Mille-Feuille Napoleon Pastry
hookLine: Caramelized crisp puff pastry slabs stacked with silky vanilla diplomat pastry cream.

items.name: All-butter puff pastry sheets (dusted with icing sugar)
Vanilla pastry cream folded with whipped cream

steps.title: Heat Oil & Prep Cooling Rack
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour neutral frying oil into a heavy pot to 2 inches deep and heat steadily to 350°F (175°C). Set a wire cooling rack over paper towels nearby and measure out {puff_mf} so everything is ready to fry cleanly.

steps.title: Bake Puff Under Second Tray
steps.instructionTemplate: Prick {puff_mf} with a fork, dust with icing sugar, cover with parchment + a second baking sheet to keep flat, and bake at 400°F (205°C) for 20 mins.
steps.creatorSecret: Weighting the pastry between two trays keeps the layers thin, even, and extra shattering.

steps.title: Pipe Cream Between Crisp Slabs
steps.instructionTemplate: Slice into rectangles and pipe neat pearls of {cream_mf} between three crisp layers. Drain briefly on a wire cooling rack lined with paper towels for 1–2 minutes so the outside stays shatteringly crisp, then plate into 6 servings and enjoy warm.
steps.creatorSecret: Glaze or toss in sugar while still warm so the coating melts lightly and clings to every ridge.

steps.title: Drain Crisp, Toss & Serve Fresh
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer to the wire rack to drain excess oil for 1–2 minutes while still piping hot, then finish with {cream_mf}. Serve French Mille-Feuille Napoleon Pastry fresh while the exterior is shatteringly crisp.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 35 mins.
